invitations.instructions: Configure the contents of the article submission form, the email notification sent for when a new submission is posted, and the time when the article submission will open (activation) and the article submission due date.

title.description: Title of paper. Add TeX formulas using the following formats: $In-line Formula$ or $$Block Formula$$.

authors.description:
Search author profile by name or profile ID. All authors must have an OpenReview profile prior to submitting a paper. Note that **no authors can be added or removed after the abstract submission deadline** (author order can be changed after the abstract submission deadline up to the full paper deadline).
######
ICLR 2027 limits authors to a maximum of 20 submissions. Do not create duplicate OpenReview profiles to subvert this limit. **Creating duplicate profiles is a violation of OpenReview terms of use, and can result in desk rejection of all your papers and suspension from OpenReview for 6 months or more.**

param.mismatchError: must be a valid profile ID

TLDR.description: "Too Long; Didn't Read": a short sentence describing your paper

abstract.description: Abstract of paper. Add TeX formulas using the following formats: $In-line Formula$ or $$Block Formula$$.

pdf.description: Upload a PDF file that ends with .pdf. The maximum file size is 50MB.

supplementary_material.description: All supplementary material must be self-contained and zipped into a single file. Note that supplementary material will be visible to reviewers and the public throughout and after the review period, and ensure all material is anonymized. The maximum file size is 100MB.

code_of_ethics.description: See the ICLR Code of Ethics: https://iclr.cc/public/CodeOfEthics.

enum.description: I and all co-authors of this work have read, and commit to adhering to the ICLR Code of Ethics.

I and all co-authors of this work understand that all papers submitted to ICLR become public at the beginning of the review process, and both accepted and rejected papers will be de-anonymized at the end of the review process. (Withdrawn papers are de-anonymized immediately upon withdrawal.) We acknowledge that papers cannot be deleted, hidden, or retracted once reviewing begins.

I and all co-authors agree to abide by the reciprocal reviewing requirement, the AI disclosure requirement, and all other submission instructions described in https://iclr.cc/Conferences/2027/AuthorGuidelines.

reciprocal_reviewing_author.description:
ICLR 2027 has a reciprocal reviewing requirement as described in https://iclr.cc/Conferences/2027/AuthorGuidelines. **If none of the authors are registered as a reviewer, it may result in a desk rejection at the discretion of the Program Chairs.**
######
Please enter the profile ID of the author who agrees to register as a reviewer to satisfy the reciprocal reviewing requirement. If the submission has no eligible reciprocal reviewer, simply enter any author in this field.
- You can check your eligibility as a reciprocal reviewer here: https://openreview.net/group?id=ICLR.cc/2027/Conference/Reciprocal_Reviewing_Check.
######
If you are a qualified reciprocal reviewer and have not yet received an invitation to review, please fill out the reviewer self-nomination form at https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe50IB-kmgf9ELdinthHsCPHV4CCzK17RaS5GHzjXyBHIqupw/viewform 
######
If you wish to ask for an exemption (e.g., no authors are qualified to be reviewers because they are first-time authors), please fill the next field.
######
**[Note that this field cannot be changed after the abstract deadline.]**

enum: ${3/authors/value/*/username}

Papers at the 2026 edition of CVPR, ECCV, EACL, IJCAI, IROS, RSS, CoRL, KDD, CoLT or AAAI:

These papers may not be indexed by the automated checker at the link above, but do count and will be verified offline during the reviewer matching process.
######
**[Note that this field cannot be changed after the abstract deadline.]**

enum.description: The designated reciprocal reviewer's only qualifying paper is at the 2026 edition of CVPR, ECCV, EACL, IJCAI, IROS, RSS, CoRL, KDD, CoLT or AAAI.

reciprocal_reviewing_exemption.description:
If requesting an exemption to the reciprocal reviewing requirement, please choose the reason why you need an exemption. If not requesting an exemption, please select “We do not need an exemption”.
######
**[Note that this field cannot be changed after the abstract deadline.]**

enum: We do not need an exemption.
We want an exemption because all authors are unqualified (i.e., no author has a publication on the approved venue list).
We want an exemption because all qualified authors have already accepted to serve as ACs/SACs/other chair in the ICLR 2027 Program/Organizing committee.
We want an exemption because all qualified authors will be on medical/parental leave.
We want an exemption because all qualified authors are Program Chairs for other conferences.
I believe the submission is exempt for a different reason, specified below.

reciprocal_reviewing_exemption_reason.description:
If you believe this submission is exempt from the reciprocal reviewing requirement for a different reason, please enter it here.
######
**[Note that this field cannot be changed after the abstract deadline.]**

AI_assistance.description:
Did you use Large Language Models (LLMs) or other AI tools in paper writing? (click all that apply).
######
**Authors are required to disclose AI use in a mandatory section in their paper, per ICLR 2027 policy** https://iclr.cc/Conferences/2027/AIPolicyForAuthors. **Failing to do so can lead to desk rejection.**

enum: No, not at all.
Yes, to aid or polish writing. Details are described in the paper.
Yes, for retrieval and discovery (e.g., finding related work). Details are described in the paper.
Yes, for research ideation or execution. Details are described in the paper.
Yes, to draft sections of the paper. Details are described in the paper.
Yes, for generating synthetic datasets. Details are described in the paper.
Yes, for proving mathematical claims. Details are described in the paper.
Yes, but for none of the above purposes. Details are described in the paper.

ready_for_LLM_feedback.description:
ICLR 2027 provides an optional early LLM-powered feedback on your submission via Google's Paper Assistant Tool, which is available only to authors for improving their manuscript. The feedback is not revealed to the reviewing body; see https://blog.iclr.cc/2026/09/10/making-googles-paper-assistant-tool-pat-available-to-iclr-submitters/ for more details. **Selecting this checkbox triggers the LLM feedback request and uses the single available feedback voucher for the submitting user. The program ends on the abstract deadline Sep 18th (Anywhere on Earth).** High demand may create processing delays, so we encourage authors not to wait until the deadline to request feedback.
######
By checking this box you agree to Google's [terms](https://policies.google.com/terms?hl=en-US).

enum: The submitted PDF is ready for LLM feedback.

LLM_feedback_request.description: First author who marked paper ready for LLM feedback.
